department: Faculty of Science — Department of Mathematics

deadline.value: Application deadlines are not exposed on the accessible Mathematics page (science.nus.edu.sg FAQ blocked by Imperva/Incapsula and accordion sections collapsed).

gre_subject.value: Mathematics encourages GRE scores generally without specifying whether the GRE Mathematics Subject Test is required.

supervisor.value: The prospective PhD in Mathematics page does not state whether pre-admission supervisor agreement is required.

funding.value: Admission is competitive with scholarship eligibility; the majority of current full-time graduate students receive some form of financial support.
funding.quote: Admission is on a competitive basis and eligible applicants may apply for Scholarship or other forms of financial assistance when applying for admission. Majority of the Department’s current full-time graduate students are given some form of financial support.

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold at least an Honours degree or equivalent from a reputable university.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have at least an Honours degree or its equivalent from a reputable university.

gre_general.value: Standardised GRE scores are strongly encouraged and will significantly strengthen the application.
gre_general.quote: Standardised scores of TOEFL/IELTS & GRE will significantly strengthen the application to the university and strongly encouraged.

notes: Department page has collapsed accordions for Fees & Scholarships and Application Procedure; FAQ link points to science.nus.edu.sg (WAF-blocked).
